evidence: Agent-visible text is task/instruction.md plus /instructions (Dockerfile: COPY instructions/ /instructions/, which holds only hireops_rules.md and integration.md; tests/ is not copied). Ran the skill's grep (quality-checks.md:26) case-insensitively over all three files, extended with score|probe|gate|grader|verifier|polish|functional|visual|checker|GATE-: zero hits. No criterion id appears: 55 distinct hro_* ids extracted from tests/**/*.toml|*.md, none present in brief or notes; no 'NOT EXERCISED', 'binary', CHANGE_ME/TODO/TBD markers. Longest verbatim word overlap with any tests file: instruction.md 5 words (account list shared with tests/app_context.md), hireops_rules.md 8 words ('place the reason is shown and keyboard focus' vs scored/functional/judge.toml hro_refused_put_back), integration.md 2 words; these are the public requirement restated by the criterion, not criterion text leaking into the brief. Numbers in the brief (15 seconds, page size 30, 1-50 interview places) are product requirements, not grader weights or probe literals. The brief never names the judge, Playwright, dimensions, reward weights, test paths or sentinels; instruction.md:11 points only to /instructions notes. Frozen brief/notes bytes match current projects/ copies (sha256 256c5b5d..., 38fff76c..., 1b56dd3f...). Counterexample attempts: a broken app cannot exploit leaked probe values because none are disclosed; a conforming alternative is not penalised by anything in the brief. Limitation: this is a manual application of the check and of check-instruction-hygiene.py's documented behaviour; the private checker executable was not run (owned by the deterministic reviewer).
